name: "Bavarian Cream" Double Glazed Donut - 1.5G
description:
Bavarian Cream -
Smooth, decadent, and silky at the edges, Bavarian Cream is a dessert-driven experience that blends velvety sweetness with a subtle undercurrent of richness. The flavor opens with waves of vanilla custard and fluffy pastry dough, glazed lightly with powdered sugar. Just as the creaminess settles in, a delicate swirl of floral spice and faint gas rounds out the profile, giving depth to the indulgence. The effect is balanced and approachable; heavy without couch locking, soothing without sedating—like sinking into a soft chair with a perfectly filled donut in hand. Bavarian Cream is pure comfort with a refined finish.
